Weekly Metrics

Total Tickets: {{totalTicketsCount}}
New Tickets: {{totalNewTicketsCount}} 		Resolved Tickets: {{totalResolvedTicketsCount}}
High Severity: {{totalResolvedTicketsWithHighSeverityCount}} 		High Severity: {{totalHighSeverityTicketsCount}}
New High Severity: {{totalNewHighSeverityTicketsCount}}

Percentage per Change Type

Standard: {{#=}}round({{totalStandardChangeTypeCount}} / ({{totalStandardChangeTypeCount}} + {{totalConfigurationChangeTypeCount}} + {{totalDocumentationChangeTypeCount}} + {{totalManufacturingChangeTypeCount}} + {{totalSupplierQualityChangeTypeCount}}) * 100, 2){{/}}% Configuration: {{#=}}round({{totalConfigurationChangeTypeCount}} / ({{totalStandardChangeTypeCount}} + {{totalConfigurationChangeTypeCount}} + {{totalDocumentationChangeTypeCount}} + {{totalManufacturingChangeTypeCount}} + {{totalSupplierQualityChangeTypeCount}}) * 100, 2){{/}}% Documentation: {{#=}}round({{totalDocumentationChangeTypeCount}} / ({{totalStandardChangeTypeCount}} + {{totalConfigurationChangeTypeCount}} + {{totalDocumentationChangeTypeCount}} + {{totalManufacturingChangeTypeCount}} + {{totalSupplierQualityChangeTypeCount}}) * 100, 2){{/}}% Manufacturing Process/Quality: {{#=}}round({{totalManufacturingChangeTypeCount}} / ({{totalStandardChangeTypeCount}} + {{totalConfigurationChangeTypeCount}} + {{totalDocumentationChangeTypeCount}} + {{totalManufacturingChangeTypeCount}} + {{totalSupplierQualityChangeTypeCount}}) * 100, 2){{/}}% Supplier Quality: {{#=}}round({{totalSupplierQualityChangeTypeCount}} / ({{totalStandardChangeTypeCount}} + {{totalConfigurationChangeTypeCount}} + {{totalDocumentationChangeTypeCount}} + {{totalManufacturingChangeTypeCount}} + {{totalSupplierQualityChangeTypeCount}}) * 100, 2){{/}}%

Status Breakdown

Total Submitted: {{totalSubmittedCount}} Total Ready for Prioritization: {{totalReadyForPrioritizationCount}} Total Needs More Information: {{totalNeedsMoreInfoCount}} Total Prioritized: {{totalPrioritizedCount}} Total In Approval: {{totalInApprovalCount}}
Total Approved: {{totalApprovedCount}} Total Implemented: {{totalImplementedCount}} Total Rejected: {{totalRejectedCount}} Total Cancelled: {{totalCancelledCount}}

{{highSeverityTickets}} {{newTickets}} {{agingTickets}}

Appendix – Metric Definitions
Total Tickets All open post-tooled tickets (excluding Approved, Implemented, Rejected, and Cancelled) updated within the last 7 days.
New Tickets All post-tooled tickets created within the last 7 days.
Resolved Tickets All post-tooled tickets resolved within the last 7 days.
High Severity (Resolved) All post-tooled tickets resolved within the last 7 days with High Severity.
High Severity (Open) All open post-tooled tickets updated within the last 7 days with High Severity.
New High Severity All post-tooled tickets created in the last 7 Days with High Severity.

Note: Only a maximum of 100 tickets can be queried
